summary: Individual opposes eliminating E-Rate and supports preserving it for all eligible schools and libraries, emphasizing the importance of reliable internet access for libraries and communities.

claims.argument: Restricting E-Rate based primarily on geography would overlook the needs of communities and shift costs onto local libraries and taxpayers.
claims.evidence_quote: Urban and suburban libraries also serve people experiencing financial hardship and digital exclusion. Restricting E-Rate based primarily on geography would overlook the needs of these communities and shift costs onto local libraries and taxpayers.
